title: PMSV FSSAI Helper: subtype dossier batch 2 (2026-10-13)
purpose: Official-source desk review; does NOT reclassify original 533 product ledger or declare product compliance.
provenance: Clauses and definitions observed in official FSSAI 2022 compendium and 2025 official FSSAI paper; require current amendment validation before use as active rules.
significant_rules: No transfer of ingredient-only contaminant limits to compound finished foods.
Food category number is not itself a legal composition standard.
Product identity gate plus processing/form/formulation must be positive before match.
No 'PASS' until current primary source + additive/microbiology/contaminant/residue routes are independently checked.
Variant routes here are research rows, not necessarily distinct rows in existing 533-product ledger.

records.name: Milk chocolate
records.identity_gate: Contains the prescribed cocoa materials and milk solids including milk fat
records.do_not_assume: Do not classify white chocolate or analogue on milk chocolate alone
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Milk covering chocolate
records.identity_gate: Milk chocolate suitable for covering purposes
records.do_not_assume: Coating application does not remove minimum ingredient standards
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Plain chocolate
records.identity_gate: Cocoa-based plain chocolate with sugar and cocoa butter
records.do_not_assume: Dark-specific criteria must not be imposed on all plain chocolate without identity
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Dark chocolate
records.identity_gate: Declared dark chocolate; check dry-matter cocoa solids, cocoa butter and fat-free cocoa solids
records.do_not_assume: Do not accept colour/marketing term alone as proof of composition
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Plain covering chocolate
records.identity_gate: Plain chocolate produced for covering purposes
records.do_not_assume: Not interchangeable with milk covering chocolate
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Blended chocolate
records.identity_gate: Blend of milk chocolate and plain chocolate
records.do_not_assume: A mix of cocoa powder and milk powder alone is not automatically blended chocolate
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: White chocolate
records.identity_gate: Cocoa butter, milk solids including milk fat and sugar
records.do_not_assume: Do not inherit plain-chocolate total cocoa-solid rules unexamined
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Filled chocolate
records.identity_gate: Distinct centre plus chocolate coating of a specified type; chocolate component at least 25% of finished mass in 2022 source
records.do_not_assume: Do not classify sugar-centre-filled hard candy as filled chocolate merely because both are filled
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Composite chocolate
records.identity_gate: Chocolate mass fraction at least 60%, specified edible inclusions at least 10% in 2022 source
records.do_not_assume: Not any chocolate with nuts or cereal; confirm finished composition
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Praline
records.identity_gate: Single mouthful size; chocolate component at least 25% in 2022 source
records.do_not_assume: Do not treat all nut confectionery as praline
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Couverture chocolate
records.identity_gate: Dry-matter total cocoa solids, cocoa butter and fat-free solids must meet couverture criteria
records.do_not_assume: Do not assume any enrobing/coating chocolate is couverture
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Cocoa powder (regular)
records.identity_gate: Powder from cocoa press cake or cocoa mass; cocoa butter not less than 20% dry basis in 2022 table
records.do_not_assume: Not identical to cocoa drink mix or alkalised drink preparation
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Cocoa powder (medium fat-reduced)
records.identity_gate: Verify cocoa butter on dry basis against specific medium-fat band (2022 table 10-20%)
records.do_not_assume: Do not use regular powder cocoa butter minimum without subtype
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Cocoa powder (highly fat-reduced)
records.identity_gate: Verify low-fat cocoa butter upper bound (2022 table max 10%)
records.do_not_assume: Do not use regular cocoa powder fat minimum
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Cocoa mass / cocoa liquor
records.identity_gate: Ground clean practically shell-free cocoa nibs; check mass-specific table, including cocoa butter 47-60% in 2022
records.do_not_assume: Do not classify as finished chocolate solely due to cocoa solids
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Cocoa press cake
records.identity_gate: Cake by partial/complete fat removal from cocoa nib or mass
records.do_not_assume: Do not apply cocoa-mass 47-60% fat requirement to cake
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Sweetened cocoa / drinking chocolate (standard)
records.identity_gate: Direct-consumption dry cocoa-sugar mix; regular fat-category cocoa powder and applicable mix cocoa content
records.do_not_assume: Not plain cocoa powder under 2.7.7
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Sweetened cocoa, fat-reduced / drinking chocolate
records.identity_gate: Direct-consumption cocoa-sugar mix using fat-reduced cocoa category
records.do_not_assume: Not regular-fat or highly reduced group
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Sweetened cocoa, highly fat-reduced / drinking chocolate
records.identity_gate: Direct-consumption cocoa-sugar mix using highly fat-reduced cocoa category
records.do_not_assume: Not regular cocoa-mix column
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Sweetened cocoa mix
records.identity_gate: Cocoa-sugar mixture; verify intended cocoa-powder fraction and naming table row
records.do_not_assume: Do not treat as cocoa powder as an ingredient
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Sweetened cocoa mix, fat-reduced
records.identity_gate: Confirm mix category and medium-fat cocoa basis
records.do_not_assume: Do not inherit plain cocoa-powder limits without mix matrix
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Sweetened cocoa-flavoured mix
records.identity_gate: Cocoa-sugar product meeting corresponding reduced-cocoa naming tier
records.do_not_assume: A cocoa flavour claim cannot replace measured cocoa-content classification
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Chocolate powder for beverage
records.identity_gate: Mix of cocoa powder and sugar/sweeteners; cocoa powder at least 32% wt/wt (29% dry-matter basis) in 2022 source
records.do_not_assume: Do not automatically treat as cocoa mass or retail chocolate
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Preserved fruit juice for industrial use
records.identity_gate: Unfermented but fermentable mechanically obtained fruit juice with permitted preservatives; industrial-use restriction
records.do_not_assume: Not regular consumer-ready fruit juice without industrial-use qualifier
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Preserved fruit pulp/puree for industrial use
records.identity_gate: Sound ripe fruit pulp/puree preserved for industrial use
records.do_not_assume: Fruit pulp and finished fruit cheese have different product identity
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Preserved vegetable pulp/puree for industrial use
records.identity_gate: Sound ripe vegetable pulp/puree for industrial use with permitted preservatives
records.do_not_assume: Not cooked vegetable puree unless processed accordingly
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Concentrated preserved fruit juice for industrial use
records.identity_gate: Preserved juice concentrate with soluble solids at least twice original juice/puree basis as applicable
records.do_not_assume: Do not conflate with nonconcentrated preserved fruit juice
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Concentrated preserved fruit/vegetable puree for industrial use
records.identity_gate: Water removed; soluble solids at least twice corresponding original product under referenced standards
records.do_not_assume: Not automatically the consumer fruit puree category
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Tamarind pulp/puree
records.identity_gate: Tamarind boiled in water and sieved; 2022 TSS/acidity/ash requirements specific to pulp/puree
records.do_not_assume: Do not use concentrate minima
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Tamarind concentrate
records.identity_gate: Evaporated tamarind pulp/puree; 2022 concentrate requirements distinct from pulp
records.do_not_assume: Do not use plain pulp/puree minima
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Fruit bar
records.identity_gate: Fruit pulp/puree blended and dehydrated as a sheet for cutting; check fruit-content and moisture requirements
records.do_not_assume: Not any hard-boiled candy with fruit flavour
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Fruit toffee
records.identity_gate: Fruit-based sheet product described in fruit bar/toffee standard
records.do_not_assume: Not necessarily sugar-boiled confectionery toffee
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Fruit/vegetable cereal flakes
records.identity_gate: Pulp/puree with starch/cereals and sweeteners dried to flakes; check 2022 moisture/ash/starch
records.do_not_assume: Not dehydrated fruit alone
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Squash
records.identity_gate: Fruit juice/puree sweetened beverage concentrate; 2022 table separate squash thresholds
records.do_not_assume: Do not use crush or cordial TSS row
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Fruit crush
records.identity_gate: Crush product within fruit beverage syrup group; 2022 table different TSS from squash
records.do_not_assume: Not finished fruit bar
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Fruit syrup / fruit sharbat
records.identity_gate: Sweetened fruit juice/puree/concentrate syrup; confirm fruit juice/puree and TSS in 2022 table
records.do_not_assume: Do not apply cordial's TSS row
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Cordial
records.identity_gate: Clear product from clarified fruit juice blended with sweeteners and water
records.do_not_assume: Not cloudy squash merely marketed cordial
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Barley water
records.identity_gate: Fruit juice with required barley starch (at least 0.25% in 2022 source)
records.do_not_assume: Not generic flavoured sweetened water
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Ginger cocktail / ginger beer or gingerale
records.identity_gate: Prepared by blending ginger juice or oleoresin or essence with water and nutritive sweeteners
records.do_not_assume: Do not infer alcohol content from 'beer' product name
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Fruit cheese
records.identity_gate: Fruit pulp/puree cooked with salt and sweeteners to set; 2022 TSS and fruit fraction rules
records.do_not_assume: Not dairy cheese or fruit bar/toffee
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Dehydrated fruits (pieces)
records.identity_gate: Moisture removed under controlled conditions for preservation; piece product
records.do_not_assume: Not candied glazed fruit by name only
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Dehydrated fruit powder
records.identity_gate: Preserved dry fruit powder with free-flowing, non-agglomerated form
records.do_not_assume: Not dried fruit concentrate without identity verification
records.current_corroboration: Not performed for all later gazette amendments

records.name: Partial substitution of milk fat
records.identity_gate: Analogue with non-milk fat replacing some milk fat
records.do_not_assume: This is a class/label gate, not a named finished-product composition standard. No paneer, cheese or milk composition standard transferred.
records.labelling_check: Confirm specific substituted ingredient and source; declaration 'Contains ...' as applicable
records.reference_version: FSSAI official 2025 consultation paper describing extant rules (not a new binding amendment)
records.current_corroboration: Review binding Gazette / current chapter and product label

records.name: Complete substitution of milk fat
records.identity_gate: Analogue with non-milk fat replacing all milk fat
records.do_not_assume: This is a class/label gate, not a named finished-product composition standard. No paneer, cheese or milk composition standard transferred.
records.labelling_check: Confirm no milk fat and 'Contains no milk ...' labelling as applicable
records.reference_version: FSSAI official 2025 consultation paper describing extant rules (not a new binding amendment)
records.current_corroboration: Review binding Gazette / current chapter and product label

records.name: Partial substitution of milk protein
records.identity_gate: Analogue with non-milk protein replacing some milk protein
records.do_not_assume: This is a class/label gate, not a named finished-product composition standard. No paneer, cheese or milk composition standard transferred.
records.labelling_check: Confirm ingredient and origin; distinct constituent declaration
records.reference_version: FSSAI official 2025 consultation paper describing extant rules (not a new binding amendment)
records.current_corroboration: Review binding Gazette / current chapter and product label

records.name: Complete substitution of milk protein
records.identity_gate: Analogue with non-milk protein replacing all milk protein
records.do_not_assume: This is a class/label gate, not a named finished-product composition standard. No paneer, cheese or milk composition standard transferred.
records.labelling_check: Confirm absence of milk protein and required declaration
records.reference_version: FSSAI official 2025 consultation paper describing extant rules (not a new binding amendment)
records.current_corroboration: Review binding Gazette / current chapter and product label
